name: run_command
description: Run a shell command or a complex shell script. Use background=true with a short title for long work: it returns a job_id immediately; check progress with job(action=status), stop with job(action=stop), and you are notified automatically when it finishes. Inside scripts, `miyu tool-call <name> --stdin` calls structured tools as this session. Internal calls execute in the daemon-side session workspace: they do not inherit the script's environment or working directory, so pass data between tools via argument JSON or files.

command.description: The shell command or script to run. May contain complex multi-line commands; prefer edit for file edits.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds (1-600, default 120). Ignored when background=true.

background.description: Run detached in the background and return a short job_id immediately. Suitable for commands expected to take longer than about 30 seconds.

title.description: What this command is for, at most 16 characters (e.g. "release build"). Required. The UI shows it in place of the command text, so a reader who cannot read shell still knows what the command does.
